label: HESC Inputs v1.0
info: Home EV Solar Control — triggers. Evaluation every 30 s from the HA state cache (bounded set of entities, no API reads).

label: HESC Engine v1.0
info: Release state machine: IDLE → WAIT_ACK (request on, wait for HPVC's confirmation) → WAIT_START → CHARGING → release ended (request off). Charge plan node: grid charging in planned quarters, safety net, cheap chances. Shadow mode evaluates only.

label: HESC Outputs v1.0
info: Write path (never in shadow mode): HPVC release request, charger start/stop or mode (charge plan), ownership flags; status helpers and JSONL history in /homeassistant/hesc-data/.

label: HESC Reports v1.0
info: On-demand HTML support report (settings, history, forecast vs actual). Written to /homeassistant/www/hesc/report.html → /local/hesc/report.html. Not part of the evaluation cycle.
